title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: NEW aircrafts & liveries you need to see! ✈️🔥 (Week of Jan 19, 2026)
description:
🔍 Description
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace update is absolutely packed with new aircraft and stunning livery packs — and in this video, I’ll walk you through every new addition worth your attention! ✈️✨

We’ll explore the latest lineup of newly released aircraft, including the 737 AEWC, 737‑700ER, A380‑1000, the sleek Bristell B23, the unique C‑22J Ventura, the classic DH89 Dragon Rapide, and the massive REDWING Goliath. I’ll also highlight all the fresh livery packs landing this week, from Frontier’s animal‑themed A320neo sets to PMDG’s global 737 and 777 collections.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week
The following aircrafts were newly released  in the marketplace this week:

🛫Airfoillabs: Bristell B23 
🛫Flight Replicas: DH89 Dragon Rapide 
🛫Mario Noriega Designs: C‑22J Ventura 
🛫mscenery: 737 AEWC Professional 
🛫mscenery: 737‑700ER Professional 
🛫mscenery: A380‑1000 Professional 
🛫REDWING: Goliath

✈️ New liveries added this week
The following liveries were newly released  in the marketplace this week:

🎨iniBuilds: A340 Airliner VIP Pack
🎨JED Studio: C‑47 “Flying the Hump” Liveries
🎨JED Studio: F/A‑18E U.S. Navy VFA‑2 Liveries
🎨PMDG: PMDG 737‑800 Livery Packs (Africa‑Asia‑Oceania, Americas, Europe)
🎨PMDG: PMDG 777‑200ER Livery Packs (Africa‑Asia‑Oceania, Americas, Europe)
🎨PMDG: PMDG 777‑300ER Livery Packs (Africa‑Americas‑Europe, Asia‑Oceania)
🎨PMDG: PMDG 777F Livery Packs (Africa‑Asia‑Oceania, Americas‑Europe)
🎨Salt Lake Simulations: 737 Max 8 Europe Fleet Pack
🎨Salt Lake Simulations: A320neo Frontier Land Animals Packs 1–4
🎨Salt Lake Simulations: A320neo Frontier Sky Animals Packs 1–2
